Ui.SettingsDialog.Backup.CloudWarning: ⚠ The selected folder looks like a cloud sync service (OneDrive/Dropbox/Google Drive). The database (with medicine names, dosages, doctor info) will be synced to the cloud. Make sure that's what you want.
Ui.SettingsDialog.Backup.Note:
Daily automatic backup requires MedReminder to be running at the preferred time. If the PC is off then, the backup runs at the next start of the day.
Restore overwrites the current database; a copy of the previous version is preserved as .bak-<timestamp>.

Ui.SettingsDialog.Backup.Title: Backup
Ui.SettingsDialog.Backup.RunNoDir: Select a destination folder first (and save the settings).
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.Host:
SMTP server of your email provider.
Examples: smtp.gmail.com, smtp-mail.outlook.com, smtp.mail.yahoo.com
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.Port:
TCP port of the SMTP server.
• 587: submission with StartTLS (recommended)
• 465: legacy SMTPS
• 25: unencrypted outbound relay (discouraged)
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.UseTls:
Enable StartTLS encryption on the SMTP connection.
Required by virtually every modern provider.
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.Username: SMTP login username. Usually your full email address.
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.Password:
SMTP password / App Password.

Heads up: since 2022, Gmail and Outlook.com require an 'App Password' generated in the account's security settings (2FA required). The regular account password will NOT work.

The password is encrypted with DPAPI (per Windows user) and never stored in cleartext.
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.ClearPassword: When checked, on save it removes the stored DPAPI password.
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.From: Sender address for notifications. Must be accepted by the SMTP server (usually == username).
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.FromName: Display name shown in the recipient's email client.
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.To: Address that will receive reminder emails.
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.Timeout: Timeout in seconds for opening/sending a single email. 30s is sensible for home SMTP.
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.BackupEnabled:
Enables daily automatic database backup.
If the PC is off at the preferred time, the backup runs at the next start of the day.
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.BackupDirector:
Folder where backups are saved (medreminder-YYYYMMDD-HHmmss.db).

Tip: avoid folders synced to the cloud (OneDrive, Dropbox) unless you want your medical data replicated online.
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.BackupTime:
Preferred time for the daily backup (24h local).

It's a hint, not an exact time: if the PC isn't running at that time, the backup runs at the next start of the day.
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.BackupRetentio:
Days of automatic backup retention. Older files are deleted after a successful backup.

0 = no automatic deletion (discouraged: the folder grows indefinitely).
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.BackupBrowse: Open File Explorer to choose the backup folder.
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.Language:
Interface language for menus, dialogs and email notifications.
Windows toast notifications always follow the system language.
Ui.SettingsDialog.Tooltip.CheckUpdates: When enabled, MedReminder contacts the public GitHub Releases API at startup and shows a message when a newer stable release is available. Nothing is downloaded or installed automatically.
